snippet.title: Ledgerbound - Official Trailer | IGN Live 2025
snippet.description: Check out the fun Ledgerbound trailer for this upcoming narrative tactical RPG comedy from ex-Helldivers 2 developers. Learn more about the story as you play as the world’s top strategist: an insurance adjuster gunning for a promotion. But when an ancient immortal enemy threatens life as you know it (and worse, your shot at a promotion!), you must leave your desk behind and strike out to save the world. Ledgerbound will be available on Steam.
